bullets.text: Two 14-year-old boys are feared drowned while bathing in Puzhal lake at Murugampedu, and the office should monitor search operations.
The meteorological department issued an orange alert for Chennai and a yellow alert for Thiruvallur, and the office should watch for heavy rainfall impacts.
Minister Dr. Kumar.R initiated precautionary measures for the northeast monsoon in Velachery, and the office should track flood clearance operations there.
Seeman demanded the abandonment of a clinker grinding mill project in Tiruttani Karthigeyapuram due to environmental concerns, and the office should review the project status.
Avadi cybercrime police arrested a Delhi man for a boss scam involving a private company in Ambattur, and the office should watch cyber security measures.

stories.title: Two boys feared drowned while bathing in lake in Chennai
takeaways: Two 14-year-old boys from Thirumullaivoyal are feared drowned while bathing in Puzhal lake near Ambattur.
Local authorities have launched search operations to locate the missing teenagers.
